Title: Spring Boot CRUD — Users & Products
Description:
Build a Spring Boot 3 app with two models: User and Product.

Endpoints (8 total, 4 per model):
POST /users • GET /users/{id} • PUT/PATCH /users/{id} • DELETE /users/{id}
POST /products • GET /products/{id} • PUT/PATCH /products/{id} • DELETE /products/{id}

Rules: Any DB (H2/MySQL/Postgres/Mongo). Validate: User→ name req, unique email; Product→ name req, price > 0. Return JSON with proper HTTP codes and not-found handling.

API Evidence (must submit):
Test all 8 endpoints (Postman/curl). Take clear screenshots (request + response). Paste into a Word doc in Google Drive titled API-Proof-<your-name> with brief captions. Share as “Anyone with link can view”.

Submission:
Public repo spring-crud-users-products-<your-name> with README (setup, run, DB config, sample JSON).
Paste GitHub URL + Google Drive doc link in the LMS.

Grading (100): CRUD 60, Validation/Errors 20, README/Git 10, Evidence 10.

Title: Restaurant Reservation System
Description:
This Restaurant Reservation System allows customers to book tables by submitting their guest count, name, and phone number via a form. When a reservation is made, the available "Seats Left" decrease based on the guest count, and the entry is displayed in a table at the top with columns for the customer’s name, phone, check-in time, checkout status, and a delete option. If the customer clicks "Click to Checkout", the checkout time is logged, and the seats are updated. The system also allows deleting entries, where the "Seats Left" are adjusted based on whether the customer has checked out. If the guest count exceeds the available seats, an alert appears, and the system ensures that "Seats Left" doesn’t go negative or exceed the total capacity. Duplicate names are handled optionally with an alert. This project covers key aspects of dynamic form handling, state management, and table manipulation in a restaurant reservation system. 
Note : Do not use any backend for this assignment

Title: Build a Fully Functional Calculator Web Application using JSP & Servlets
Description:
Develop a fully functional calculator using JSP, Servlets, and CSS that supports basic ( +, -, *, / ) . The UI should be responsive and interactive, resembling a real calculator. Implement a clear (C) button, and error handling for invalid inputs like division by zero. Bonus: Add calculation history and keyboard support.
